method: getComputedStyle foreground/font/opacity/ancestor backgrounds; screenshot of actual rendered glyph area; temporary transparent text-only override with unchanged geometry reveals background. Compare all changed pixels >=1 RGB level, compute WCAG sRGB luminance and minimum ratio across rendered background under glyphs. Threshold 4.5 normal text, 3 large. Regression also checks trust-list checkmark color >=4.5.
measurementCorrection: Initial diagnostic threshold >=30 missed near-white-on-white glyphs. Individual screenshot inspection exposed the failure. Recomputed all before/after pairs with >=1; preliminary PASS results discarded. No human approval inferred.
